name: klaudia Rowinska
text: Amazing communication, delivered on time. Lukas was a pleasure to work with.

name: Hannah McCarthy
text: Had a fantastic experience renting from ZNC Solutions for an event in my home. Their inventory was in great condition and had many lovely options. Delivery and pickup were seamless and pleasant. Highly recommend!

name: John Almonte
text: Wonderful experience with this company. Lucas was communicative and professional. Would highly recommend using them for your rental needs

name: Tiyé Bazzey
text: The best wall install company I've ever worked with! The walls were beautiful, clean, and exactly what we were looking for. Very knowledgable, responsive and detail oriented during the project. Extremely careful with not damaging the space during installation and deinstallation. Has your best interest and outcome in mind during the design and installation process. Process was smooth and seamless and I can't wait to work with ZNC again next year, highly recommend!

name: Annie Gonzalez
text: Everything arrived exactly as ordered and was neatly organized for easy confirmation. Working and communicating with ZNC was great. They made the rental portion of party planning incredibly easy. We'll definitely be working with them again for future events. Thanks!

name: shauna saneinejad
text: They were so quick, helpful, timely and made their communication so smooth! Very self sufficient and made my project much easier!

name: UK Mission Press Office
text: From start to finish Lukasz was a absolute pleasure to work with, he ensured we had everything we needed in terms of glassware and bar accessories and ensured everything was dropped off and picked up in time, I would recommend this company and I would use ZNC Solutions again. We hosted a high profile event and the service we received was excellent!

name: Luke Heneghan
text: Professional, prompt and high quality rentals!

name: Kathleen Reddington
text: ZNC is an excellent provider for all your party needs! They are punctual Professional, friendly, and give attention to detail! We’ve had three huge events with them and always extra satisfied! We plan to Use them for all of our events in the future . We Highly recommend ZNC!

name: Lindsey Rupp
text: We had a great experience with ZNC! Lukasz gave us a great price, set up the chairs beautifully for our wedding ceremony and removed them promptly. No hassle on our part and it was gorgeous.

name: Zeena Arturo
text: ZNC Solutions were amazing! They did a wonderful job at my son's wedding. The wedding was planned very quickly and ZNC Solutions accommodated what we wanted. They presented better solutions making the event even more beautiful.

name: Camillya Lima
text: Great service and rental options! We will use them again for our events in the future.
